Chapter 467: Chapter 11 Dragon Palace in the Palm (Please Subscribe)

“In which direction is Huailong Palace?”

Cangqing Immortal was stunned for a moment, not understanding the meaning behind Lin Yuan’s words.

Was he intending to personally visit Huailong Palace?

Indeed.

As a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King, once he personally arrived at Huailong Palace,

even if that palace master were stubborn, he would have to bow his head obediently,

...

In the Vast Spirit Realm, no True Immortal dared to defy the will of an Immortal King.

True Immortals like Cangqing Immortal and Huailong Palace Master, though they claimed to be Half-Step Immortal Kings,

were far from being an actual Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King.

Cangqing Immortal had passed the Mental and Soul Tribulations, and his soul will was strong,

but he was effortlessly toyed with by Lin Yuan, trapped in an Illusionary Realm without his knowledge.

Of course,

this was also because Lin Yuan was not an ordinary Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King,

but even the most common Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King could deal with a Half-Step Immortal King

with just a thought.

“It’s over there.”

Cangqing Immortal immediately pointed out a location,

Being a longtime rival of Huailong Palace, he naturally knew the exact location of their lair.

The only issue was that Huailong Palace relied on the core water channels of the Jiujang Domain,

and even if a group of Half-Step Immortal Kings besieged it, they couldn’t overcome it, making it as secure as a fortress,

therefore, even though Cangqing Immortal knew the location of their lair, there wasn’t much he could do about it.

In the large-scale battles between successive generations of Huailong Palace and Daode Immortal Sect,

even if Daode Immortal Sect managed to repel Huailong Palace with the help of Xuanwang Hall, it was hard to inflict real heavy damage on them,

as those dragon-blooded True Immortals would simply hide inside Huailong Palace whenever they found themselves losing.

It was akin to standing on invincible ground.

“Martial Ancestor, there’s no need for you to go personally, just grant a Celestial King’s Decree, and I can take it to Huailong Palace,”

Cangqing Immortal hesitated for a moment before speaking in a low voice.

The Celestial King’s Decree contained the breath of an Immortal King, impossible to imitate, symbolizing the will of a certain Immortal King. When the decree arrives, it’s as if the Immortal King himself has arrived.

Huailong Palace, even with audacious courage, would not dare to defy the Celestial King’s Decree.

Although the Jiujang Domain was the ‘Dragon Transformation Land’ of a Tribulation-Transcending Dragon King from many ages ago, all water tribe dragon descendants within the Jiujang Domain were, in theory, descendants of that Dragon King.

But who knows how many tens of thousands of years ago that old tale had taken place, and whether it was true or false remained unclear. Even if that Dragon King did exist, he wouldn’t risk offending another Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King over a trivial matter.

“No need for such trouble,”

Lin Yuan glanced at Cangqing Immortal and said indifferently, “Simply apprehend him.”

Having said that,

Lin Yuan raised his right hand.

Taiji forces of black and white intertwined at his fingertips, causing the space to distort slightly, and just one look at it gave Cangqing Immortal a splitting headache.

It was too profound.

It was too complex.

With just the action of Lin Yuan’s raised hand, Cangqing Immortal felt that the spatial mysteries he’d comprehended all his life were all contained within it, and they occupied only one ten-thousandth or even one hundred-thousandth of the overall mystery.

The remaining spatial profundities were far beyond Cangqing Immortal’s reach.

“Has Martial Ancestor’s mastery of spatial profundity actually reached this level?”

Cangqing Immortal was astounded within his heart, but no matter how painful his headache became, he still fixed his gaze on Lin Yuan’s raised right hand.

By observing a little longer, might there be a chance for enlightenment?

Under Cangqing Immortal’s watchful eye, Lin Yuan’s raised right hand moved towards the direction he had just indicated, palm facing down, and lightly made a grabbing motion.

…

Jiujang Domain.

Huailong Palace.

The Jiujang Domain consisted of nine great rivers, each running through dozens of Great Realms before all converging within the Jiujang Domain.

Because of this, the Jiujang Domain held a unique advantage, serving as the sacred land of the Water Tribe. Huailong Palace was a power forged by dragon descendants, connected to the core water channel of the entire Jiujang Domain.

To breach Huailong Palace, one would have to break through the core water channel of the entire Jiujang Domain,

It was this advantage that allowed Huailong Palace to thrive for millions of years;

even if they weakened at times, it didn’t affect the overall situation, as they have always been one of the dominating powers of the Jiujang Domain.

Inside Huailong Palace.

The Huailong Palace Master who had passed the Bodily Tribulation looked at the single-horned man before her and said with an icy voice, “Heavenly Dragon Nest also desires the Essence of Heavenly Water?”

Heavenly Dragon Nest was also an Overlord Level power in the Jiujang Domain, on par with Huailong Palace.

Strictly speaking, it was on par with the current Huailong Palace. Before the palace master had passed the Bodily Tribulation, Huailong Palace was slightly inferior to Heavenly Dragon Nest.

“Indeed,”

“Dragon Lord has agreed to help you fully secure that strand of Essence of Heavenly Water, but my Heavenly Dragon Nest wants half,” said the single-horned man.

“Half…”

The Huailong Palace Master’s face showed no expression.

Her mind, however, was contemplating. Having passed the Bodily Tribulation, her strength had greatly increased, and she was confident she could repel Daode Immortal Sect, and even Xuanwang Hall behind them, with some confidence.

But it was always better to be safe than sorry.

The importance of the Essence of Heavenly Water was well understood by Huailong Palace, Daode Immortal Sect, and even more so by Xuanwang Hall.

The three major forces of Xuanwang Domain would definitely do everything to prevent her at all costs.

They might even call friends and gather other Half-Step Immortal Kings from different Great Realms.

In such a scenario, she would still feel some pressure,

If she could join forces with Heavenly Dragon Nest…

The Huailong Palace Master had already made her decision in her mind.

In the past, Heavenly Dragon Nest had also approached her for cooperation, similarly expressing the intention to share half of the Essence of Heavenly Water, but she flatly refused.

Because at that time she had not passed the Bodily Tribulation, and her combat power was inferior to that of Heavenly Dragon Nest’s Dragon Lord.

If they cooperated rashly, she might end up having her palace swallowed by them.

But now things were different. Having passed the Bodily Tribulation, she was not weaker than the Dragon Lord of Heavenly Dragon Nest.

The cooperation between the two was on a nearly equal footing.

“Twenty percent,”

The Huailong Palace Master said directly.
